traits: Headlines come into focus out of a soft blur while they fade in, rather than moving across the frame.
Springs settle with a faint bounce that is only just visible, never more than a tenth of the move.
Scenes blend by a blur crossfade, a push or a zoom-through; a hard cut never appears.
The pace is unhurried: an arrival about every two seconds, on long eases.

notLike.line: calm rises and fades without any blur or bounce and keeps a longer hold; premium pulls focus out of a blur and lets a spring settle with a slight give.
kinetic is fast and slams; premium never snaps and keeps every entrance soft.

nativeMoves.move: Blur-fade headline: type sharpens out of a defocus as it fades in.
nativeMoves.transfer: A watch maker's film, the model name coming into focus over a dark ground.

nativeMoves.move: Mask-reveal plates, so a product card is uncovered along an edge as if lit.
nativeMoves.transfer: A hotel film where each room card is revealed edge-first over the previous photo.

nativeMoves.move: Opening on a blur-crossfade from the ground into the first scene, as if the lens finds the subject.
nativeMoves.transfer: A gallery opening film that starts on a soft wash and resolves into the artist's name.

pitfalls.mechanism: Several defocused items at once look like a rendering fault, and nothing reads as the first thing to see.
pitfalls.fix: Use blur-fade on the headline only; give body and plates fade or mask-reveal.

pitfalls.mistake: Raising the spring bounce for energy.
pitfalls.mechanism: Past about a tenth the settle becomes visible wobble, which reads as playful, not premium.
pitfalls.fix: Keep bounce at or under 0.12 and add energy through the music instead.

pitfalls.mechanism: Without a blend, the film loses the continuous, lens-like quality and looks like a slideshow.
pitfalls.fix: Use blur-crossfade, crossfade, push or zoom-through.

free: Which scene takes the push and which the crossfade.
Whether a plate uses mask-reveal or fade.
The ground and lighting the brand sets under the motion.
invariants: Blur only on the headline entrance and the opening blend.
